ayahs.textArabic: الۤمّۤ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: غُلِبَتِ الرُّوْمُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Gulibatir-rūm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Defeated have been the Byzantines

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْٓ اَدْنَى الْاَرْضِ وَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fī adnal-arḍi wa hum mim ba‘di galabihim sayaglibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: in the lands close-by; yet it is they who, notwithstanding this their defeat, shall be victorious

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْ بِضْعِ سِنِيْنَ ەۗ لِلّٰهِ الْاَمْرُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمِنْۢ بَعْدُ ۗوَيَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fī biḍ‘i sinīn(a), lillāhil-amru min qablu wa mim ba‘d(u), wa yauma'iżiy yafraḥul-mu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: within a few years: [for] with God rests all power of decision, first and last. And on that day will the believers [too, have cause to] rejoice

ayahs.textArabic: بِنَصْرِ اللّٰهِ ۗيَنْصُرُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُۗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Binaṣrillāh(i), yanṣuru may yasyā'(u), wa huwal-‘azīzur-raḥīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: in God’s succour: [for] He gives suc­cour to whomever He wills, since He alone is almighty, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ ۗ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهٗ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa‘dallāh(i), lā yukhlifullāhu wa‘dahū wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [This is] God’s promise. Never does God fail to fulfill His promise - but most people know [it] not:

ayahs.textArabic: يَعْلَمُوْنَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۖ وَهُمْ عَنِ الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ya‘lamūna ẓāhiram minal-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa hum ‘anil-ākhirati hum gāfilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they know but the outer surface of this world’s life, whereas of the ultimate things they are utterly un­aware.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْا فِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ ۗ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَاۤئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yatafakkarū fī anfusihim, mā khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā illā bil-ḥaqqi wa ajalim musammā(n), wa inna kaṡīram minan-nāsi biliqā'i rabbihim lakāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they never learned to think for them­selves? God has not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them without [an inner] truth and a term set [by Him]: and yet, behold, there are many people who stubbornly deny the truth that they are destined to meet their Sustainer!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْۗ كَانُوْٓا اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَّاَثَارُوا الْاَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوْهَآ اَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوْهَا وَجَاۤءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِۗ فَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qablihim, kānū asyadda minhum quwwataw wa aṡārul-arḍa wa ‘amarūhā akṡara mimmā ‘amarūhā wa jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināt(i), famā kānallāhu liyaẓlimahum wa lākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they, then, never journeyed about the earth and beheld what happened in the end to those [deniers of the truth] who lived before their time? Greater were they in power than they are; and they left a stronger impact on the earth, and built it up even better than these [are doing]; and to them [too] came their apostles with all evidence of the truth: and so, [when they rejected the truth and thereupon perished,] it was not God who wronged them, but it was they who had wronged themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسَاۤءُوا السُّوْۤاٰىٓ اَنْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَكَانُوْا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma kāna ‘āqibatal-lażīna asā'us-sū'ā an każżabū bi'āyātillāhi wa kānū bihā yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And once again: evil is bound to be the end of those who do evil by giving the lie to God’s messages and deriding them.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُهٗ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū ṡumma ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: GOD CREATES [man] in the first instance, and then brings him forth anew: and, in the end, unto Him you all will be brought back.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yublisul-mujrimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when the last Hour dawns, those who were lost in sin will be broken in spirit

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَاۤىِٕهِمْ شُفَعٰۤؤُا وَكَانُوْا بِشُرَكَاۤىِٕهِمْ كٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lam yakul lahum min syurakā'ihim syufa‘ā'u wa kānū bisyurakā'ihim kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for they will have no intercessors in the beings to whom they were wont to ascribe a share in God’s divinity, seeing that [by then] they themselves will have ceased to believe in their erstwhile blasphemous fancies.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَفَرَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yauma'iżiy yatafarraqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when the Last Hour dawns - on that Day will all [men] be sorted out:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَهُمْ فِيْ رَوْضَةٍ يُّحْبَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fahum fī rauḍatiy yuḥbarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: as for those who attained to faith and did righteous deeds, they shall be made happy in a garden of delight;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَكَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَاۤئِ الْاٰخِرَةِ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal-lażīna kafarū wa każżabū bi'āyātinā wa liqā'il-ākhirati fa'ulā'ika fil-‘ażābi muḥḍarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but as for those who refused to acknowledge the truth and gave the lie to Our messages - and (thus) to the announce­ment of a life to come - they will be given over to suffering.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa subḥānallāhi ḥīna tumsūna wa ḥīna tuṣbiḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: EXTOL, then, God’s limitless glory when you enter upon the evening hours, and when you rise at morn;

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَّحِيْنَ تُظْهِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahul-ḥamdu fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa ‘asyiyyaw wa ḥīna tuẓhirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [seeing that] unto Him is due all praise in the heavens and on earth, [glorify Him] in the afternoon as well, and when you enter upon the hour of noon.

ayahs.textArabic: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۗوَكَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wa yukhrijul-mayyita minal-ḥayyi wa yuḥyil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, wa każālika tukhrajūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He [it is who] brings forth the living out of that which is dead, and brings forth the dead out of that which is alive, and gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless: and even thus will you be brought forth [from death to life]

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ اِذَآ اَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī an khalaqakum min turābin ṡumma iżā antum basyarun tantasyirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among His wonders is this: He creates you out of dust – and then, lo! you become human beings ranging far and wide!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْٓا اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحْمَةً ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājal litaskunū ilaihā wa ja‘ala bainakum mawaddataw wa raḥmah(tan), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among His wonders is this: He creates for you mates out of your own kind. so that you might incline towards them, and He engenders love and tenderness between you: in this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who think!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ اَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَاَلْوَانِكُمْۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْعٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī khalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakhtilāfu alsinatikum wa alwānikum, inna fī żālika la'āyātil lil-‘ālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among his wonders is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your tongues and colours: for in this, behold, there are messages indeed for all who are possessed of [innate] knowledge!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاۤؤُكُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī manāmukum bil-laili wan-nahāri wabtigā'ukum min faḍlih(ī), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yasma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among His wonders is your sleep, at night or in daytime, as well as your [ability to go about in] quest of some of His bounties: in this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who [are willing to] listen!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ يُرِيْكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًا وَّيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَيُحْيٖ بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī yurīkumul-barqa khaufaw wa ṭama‘aw wa yunazzilu minas-samā'i mā'an fa yuḥyī bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among His wonders is this: He displays before you the lightning, giving rise to [both] fear and hope, and sends down water from the skies, giving life thereby to the earth after it had been lifeless: in this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who use their reason!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ السَّمَاۤءُ وَالْاَرْضُ بِاَمْرِهٖۗ  ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًۖ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ اِذَآ اَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī an taqūmas-samā'u wal-arḍu bi'amrih(ī), ṡumma iżā da‘ākum da‘watam minal-arḍi iżā antum takhrujūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among His wonders is this: the skies and the earth stand firm at His behest. [Remember all this: for] in the end, when He will call you forth from the earth with a single call - lo! you will [all] emerge [for judgment].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهٗ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahū man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), kullul lahū qānitūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, unto Him belongs every being that is in the heavens and on earth; all things devoutly obey His will.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُهٗ وَهُوَ اَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِۗ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰى فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa huwal-lażī yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū wa huwa ahwanu ‘alaih(i), wa lahul-maṡalul-a‘lā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He it is who creates [all life] in the first instance, and then brings it forth anew: and most easy is this for Him, since His is the essence of all that is most sublime in the heavens and on earth, and He alone is almighty, truly wise.

ayahs.textArabic: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَّثَلًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْۗ هَلْ لَّكُمْ مِّنْ مَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَاۤءَ فِيْ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ فَاَنْتُمْ فِيْهِ سَوَاۤءٌ تَخَافُوْنَهُمْ كَخِيْفَتِكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْۗ  كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḍaraba lakum maṡalam min anfusikum, hal lakum mim mā malakat aimānukum min syurakā'a fī mā razaqnākum fa'antum fīhi sawā'un takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum, każālika nufaṣṣilul-āyāti liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He propounds unto you a parable drawn from your own life: Would you [agree to] have some of those whom your right hands possess as [full-fledged] partners in whatever We may have bestowed upon you as sustenance, so that you [and they] would have equal shares in it, and you would fear [to make use of it without consulting] them, just as you might fear [the more powerful of] your equals? Thus clearly do We spell out these messages unto people who use their reason.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَهْوَاۤءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۗ فَمَنْ يَّهْدِيْ مَنْ اَضَلَّ اللّٰهُ ۗوَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Balittaba‘al-lażīna ẓalamū ahwā'ahum bigairi ‘ilm(in), famay yahdī man aḍallallāh(u), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But nay - they who are bent on evildoing fol­low but their own desires, without having any knowl­edge (of the truth). And who could guide those whom God has [thus] let go astray, and who (thereupon) have none to succour them?

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّيْنِ حَنِيْفًاۗ فِطْرَتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيْ فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَاۗ  لَا تَبْدِيْلَ لِخَلْقِ اللّٰهِ ۗذٰلِكَ الدِّيْنُ الْقَيِّمُۙ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa aqim wajhaka lid-dīni ḥanīfā(n), fiṭratallāhil-latī faṭaran-nāsa ‘alaihā, lā tabdīla likhalqillāh(i), żālikad-dīnul-qayyim(u), wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND SO, set thy face steadfastly towards the [one ever-true] faith, turning away from all that is false, in accordance with the natural disposition which God has instilled into man: [for,] not to allow any change to corrupt what God has thus created this is the [purpose of the one] ever-true faith; but most people know it not.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ مُنِيْبِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوْهُ وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Munībīna ilaihi wattaqūhu wa aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa lā takūnū minal-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Turn, then, away from all that is false,] turn­ing unto Him [alone]; and remain conscious of Him, and be constant in prayer, and be not among those who ascribe divinity to aught beside Him,

ayahs.textArabic: مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَّقُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ وَكَانُوْا شِيَعًا ۗ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۢ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Minal-lażīna farraqū dīnahum wa kānū syiya‘ā(n), kullu ḥizbim bimā ladaihim fariḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [or] among those who have broken the unity of their faith and have become sects, each group delighting in but what they themselves hold [by way of tenets].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُّنِيْبِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَآ اَذَاقَهُمْ مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً اِذَا فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā massan-nāsa ḍurrun da‘au rabbahum munībīna ilaihi ṡumma iżā ażāqahum minhu raḥmatan iżā farīqum minhum birabbihim yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW [thus it is:] when affliction befalls men, they cry out unto their Sustainer, turning unto Him [for help]; but as soon as He lets them taste of His grace, lo! some of them [begin to] ascribe to other powers a share in their Sustainer’s divinity,

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَكْفُرُوْا بِمَآ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْۗ فَتَمَتَّعُوْاۗ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyakfurū bimā ātaināhum, fatamatta‘ū, fasaufa ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [as if] to prove their ingratitude for all that We have granted them! Enjoy, then, your [brief] life: but in time you will come to know [the truth]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am anzalnā ‘alaihim sulṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihī yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have We ever bestowed upon them from on high a divine writ which would speak [with appro­val] of their worshipping aught beside Us?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَآ اَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْا بِهَاۗ وَاِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ ۢبِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ اِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ażaqnan-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā, wa in tuṣibhum sayyi'atum bimā qaddamat aidīhim iżā hum yaqnaṭūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [thus it is:] when we let men taste [Our] grace, they rejoice in it; but if evil befalls them as an outcome of what their own hands have wrought lo! they lose all hope!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيَقْدِرُۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they, then, not aware that it is God who grants abundant sustenance, or gives it in scant measure, unto whomever He wills? In this, behold, there are messages indeed for peo­ple who will believe!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاٰتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَالْمِسْكِيْنَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيْلِۗ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ يُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِ ۖوَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa āti żal-qurbā ḥaqqahū wal-miskīna wabnas-sabīl(i), żālika khairul lil-lażīna yurīdūna wajhallāh(i), wa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, give his due to the near of kin, as well as to the needy and the wayfarer; this is best for all who seek God’s countenance: for it is they, they that shall attain to a happy state!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اٰتَيْتُمْ مِّنْ رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِيْٓ اَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوْا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۚوَمَآ اٰتَيْتُمْ مِّنْ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ātaitum mir ribal liyarbuwa fī amwālin-nāsi falā yarbū ‘indallāh(i), wa mā ātaitum min zakātin turīdūna wajhallāhi fa'ulā'ika humul-muḍ‘ifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [remember:] whatever you may give out in usury so that it might increase through [other] people’s possessions will bring [you] no increase in the sight of God whereas all that you give out in charity, seeking God’s countenance, [will be blessed by Him:] for it is they, they [who thus seek His countenance] that shall have their recompense mul­tiplied!

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيْكُمْۗ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَاۤىِٕكُمْ مَّنْ يَّفْعَلُ مِنْ ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍۗ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī khalaqakum ṡumma razaqakum ṡumma yumītukum ṡumma yuḥyīkum, hal min syurakā'ikum may yaf‘alu min żālikum min syai'(in), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: IT IS GOD who has created you, and then has provided you with sustenance, and then will cause you to die, and then will bring you to life again. Can any of those beings or powers to whom you ascribe a share in His divinity do any of these things? Limitless is He in His glory, and sublimely exalted above anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِى النَّاسِ لِيُذِيْقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِيْ عَمِلُوْا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żaharal-fasādu fil-barri wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aidin-nāsi liyużīqahum ba‘ḍal-lażī ‘amilū la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Since they have become oblivious of God,] corruption has appeared on land and in the sea as an outcome of what men’s hands have wrought: and so He will let them taste [the evil of] some of their doings, so that they might return [to the right path].

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ سِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُۗ  كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qabl(u), kāna akṡaruhum musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Go all over the earth, and behold what happened in the end to those [sinners] who lived before [you]: most of them were wont to ascribe divine qualities to things or beings other than God.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّيْنِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّصَّدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa aqim wajhaka lid-dīnil-qayyimi min qabli ay ya'tiya yaumul lā maradda lahū minallāhi yauma'iżiy yaṣṣadda‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Set, then, thy face steadfastly towards the one ever-true faith, ere there come from God a Day [of reckoning - the Day] which cannot be averted. On that Day all will be sundered:

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهٗۚ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِاَنْفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Man kafara fa ‘alaihi kufruh(ū), wa man ‘amila ṣāliḥan fali'anfusihim yamhadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: he who has denied the truth will have to bear [the burden of] his denial, whereas all who did what is right and just will have made goodly provision for themselves,

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖۗ  اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyajziyal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlih(ī), innahū lā yuḥibbul-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that He might reward, out of His bounty, those who have attained to faith and done righteous deeds. Verily, He does not love those who refuse to acknowledge the truth –

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ يُّرْسِلَ الرِّيٰحَ مُبَشِّرٰتٍ وَّلِيُذِيْقَكُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِهٖ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min āyātihī ay yursilar-riyāḥa mubasysyirātiw wa liyużīqakum mir raḥmatihī wa litajriyal-fulka bi'amrihī wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for among His wonders is this: He sends forth [His messages as He sends forth] the winds that bear glad tidings, so that He might give you a taste of His grace [through life-giving rains], and that ships might sail at His behest, and that you might go about in quest of some of His bounties, and that you might have cause to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاۤءُوْهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اَجْرَمُوْاۗ وَكَانَ حَقًّاۖ عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qaumihim fajā'ūhum bil-bayyināti fantaqamnā minal-lażīna ajramū, wa kāna ḥaqqan ‘alainā naṣrul-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And indeed, [O Muhammad, even] before thee did We send forth apostles - each one unto his own people and they brought them all evidence of the truth: and then, [by causing the believers to triumph,] We inflicted Our retribution upon those who [de­liberately] did evil: for We had willed it upon Our­selves to succour the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ فَتُثِيْرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهٗ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ كَيْفَ يَشَاۤءُ وَيَجْعَلُهٗ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلٰلِهٖۚ فَاِذَآ اَصَابَ بِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖٓ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī yursilur-riyāḥa fatuṡīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhū fis-samā'i kaifa yasyā'u wa yaj‘aluhū kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilālih(ī), fa'iżā aṣāba bihī may yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī iżā hum yastabsyirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is God who sends forth the winds [of hope], so that they raise a cloud - whereupon He spreads it over the skies as He wills, and causes it to break up so that thou seest rain issue from within it: and as soon as He causes it to fall upon whomever He wills of His servants - lo! they rejoice,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَمُبْلِسِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in kānū min qabli ay yunazzala ‘alaihim min qablihī lamublisīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: even though a short while ago, [just] before it was sent down upon them, they had abandoned all hope!

ayahs.textArabic: فَانْظُرْ اِلٰٓى اٰثٰرِ رَحْمَتِ اللّٰهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاۗ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰىۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Fanẓur ilā āṡāri raḥmatillāhi kaifa yuḥyil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, inna żālika lamuḥyil-mautā, wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, then, [O man,] these signs of God’s grace - how He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless! Verily, this Selfsame [God] is indeed the One that can bring the dead back to life: for He has the power to will anything!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَىِٕنْ اَرْسَلْنَا رِيْحًا فَرَاَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ يَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa la'in arsalnā rīḥan fara'auhu muṣfarral laẓallū mim ba‘dihī yakfurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But thus it is: if We send a wind [that scorches their land], and they see it turn yellow, they begin, after that [erstwhile joy], to deny the truth [of Our almightiness and grace]!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰى وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاۤءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa innaka lā tusmi‘ul-mautā wa lā tusmi‘uṣ-ṣummad-du‘ā'a iżā wallau mudbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, verily, thou canst not make the dead hear: and [so, too,] thou canst not make the deaf [of heart] hear this call when they turn their backs [on thee] and go away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَنْتَ بِهٰدِ الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلٰلَتِهِمْۗ اِنْ تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَنْ يُّؤْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā anta bihādil-‘umyi ‘an ḍalālatihim, in tusmi‘u illā may yu'minu bi'āyātinā fahum muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: just as thou canst not lead the blind [of heart] out of their error: none canst thou make hear [thy call] save such as [are willing to] believe in Our messages, and thus surrender them­selves unto Us.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَّشَيْبَةً ۗيَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاۤءُۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْقَدِيْرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī khalaqakum min ḍa‘fin ṡumma ja‘ala mim ba‘di ḍa‘fin quwwatan ṡumma ja‘ala mim ba‘di quwwatin ḍa‘faw wa syaibah(tan), yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), wa huwal-‘alīmul-qadīr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: IT IS GOD who creates you [all in a states of weak­ness, and then, after weakness, ordains strength [for you], and then, after [a period of] strength, ordains [old-age] weakness and grey hair. He creates what He wills; and He alone is all-knowing, infinite in His power.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ ەۙ مَا لَبِثُوْا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۗ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْا يُؤْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yuqsimul-mujrimūn(a), mā labiṡū gaira sā‘ah(tin), każālika kānū yu'fakūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [He it is who will cause you to die, and in time will resurrect you.] And when the Last Hour dawns, those who had been lost in sin will swear that they had not tarried [on earth] longer than an hour: thus were they wont to delude themselves [all their lives]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْاِيْمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِۖ فَهٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma wal-īmāna laqad labiṡtum fī kitābillāhi ilā yaumil-ba‘ṡ(i), fa hāżā yaumul-baṡi wa lākinnakum kuntum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But those who [in their lifetime] were endowed with knowledge and faith will say: “Indeed, you have been tardy in [accepting as true] what God has revealed, [and you have waited] until the Day of Resurrection: this, then, is the Day of Resurrection: but you - you were determined not to know it!

ayahs.textArabic: فَيَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa yauma'iżil lā yanfa‘ul-lażīna ẓalamū ma‘żiratuhum wa lā hum yusta‘tabūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, on that Day their excuse will be of no avail to those who were bent on evildoing, nor will they be allowed to make amends.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍۗ وَلَىِٕنْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ لَّيَقُوْلَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا مُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ḍarabnā lin-nāsi fī hāżal-qur'āni min kulli maṡal(in), wa la'in ji'tahum bi'āyatil layaqūlannal-lażīna kafarū in antum illā mubṭilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, We have propounded unto men all kinds of parables in this Qur’an. But thus it is: if thou approach them with any [such] message, those who are bent on denying the truth are sure to say, “You are but making false claims!”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Każālika yaṭba‘ullāhu ‘alā qulūbil-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this way does God seal the hearts of those who do not [want to] know [the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Faṣbir inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqquw wa lā yastakhiffannakal-lażīna lā yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Remain, then, patient in adversity: verily, Gods promise [of resurrection] is true indeed - so let not those who are devoid of all inner certainty disquiet thy mind!
